Class VectorStore

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.ai.VectorStore
public final class VectorStore extends Object
High-level document store backed by CockroachDB's native VECTOR type.

Handles schema creation, embedding generation (via an EmbeddingProvider), upserts, deletes, and similarity search. For low-level control over arbitrary tables use VectorSearchTemplate instead.

Vector values are interpolated as numeric literals (safe: they contain only digits, signs, dots, and commas); ids, content, and metadata are bound as statement parameters.
